1.  Starships – Pure floating-on-a-yacht, champagne-popping, zero-worries energy
2.  Super Bass – Cheeky, bouncy, and impossible not to smile (and grind a little) to
3.  Beauty And A Beat – Smooth, glittery dance-floor glow that feels like the best night of your life
4.  The Night Is Still Young – That late-night “we’re not done yet” warmth mixed with soft nostalgia
5.  Megatron – Straight-up boss-mode fire; confident, loud, and unapologetic.
6.  Everybody – Big, inclusive party wave that pulls the whole room in
7.  Super Freaky Girl – Playful and proudly over-the-top fun
8.  Moment 4 Life – Dreamy, triumphant, and full of that “we made it” glow
9.  Truffle Butter – Smooth, late-night luxury with a sly little wink
10.  Beez in the Trap – Grimy, hard-hitting, and pure street-queen attitude
11.  Pink Friday Girls – Bright, nostalgic girl-power celebration that feels like a group hug in song form
